common.light_controls_check: Supported light controls are checked from the device.
common.help_button_action: Press executes the selected action. A Flow trigger can add additional automation.
common.help_alarm_binding: Alarm arming, disarming and PIN handling are separate control actions. Binding follows the Homey alarm device state.
common.help_source_flow: Value comes from Flow. Update the value with this view's Flow card. Homey binding does not replace it.
common.help_source_fixed: This is a start value. Flow can update it later.
common.help_source_homey: Value comes from the selected Homey device. Flow can supplement title, icon or other details; device state remains Homey-controlled. Choose Flow source if you also want to provide state yourself.
common.power_default_note: Default power is shown until Flow updates the value.
common.power_flow_note: Power and speed come from a Flow action. Before the first value, the previously set default power is shown.
common.power_device_note: Power updates from the selected device. Speed is determined automatically from power.
common.speed_help: 0 = automatic speed, 1–100 = custom speed. At zero power the point stops.
common.weather_preview_info: The next five days are filled from the selected weather forecast. Choose MET Norway or Flow in screensaver settings. Preview lines are placeholders, not observations.
common.alarm_pin_help: Set a numeric PIN code for alarm acknowledgement. Leave empty if no PIN is required.
common.setoption111_help: Enables buzzer PWM control (polyphonic beeps and ringtones).
common.global_pin_help: This PIN is used for protected buttons and pages unless they have their own code.
